name: cause
title: Cause
description: A trust-first charity theme whose mission hero is one impact number set huge in warm ochre, one verb and — when you have it — one human photograph, then a donate button, in deep teal on white with nothing decorative.

tokens.--font-display: headings, the site title, and the impact number
tokens.--text-s: meta text — dates, captions, the footer
tokens.--text-l: ledes, large buttons and the figures in tables
tokens.--text-xl: section headings, list titles and the words under the impact number
tokens.--text-impact: size of the hero impact number, the one loud thing; beside a photograph it shrinks to fit its column
tokens.--leading-lede: line height of ledes — the larger opening sentence under a page title
tokens.--tracking-display: letter-spacing of headings; the impact number is set twice as tight
tokens.--weight-display: boldness of headings, buttons, labels and the verb under the impact number
tokens.--color-accent: deep teal — links, focus rings, the donate button, and the last menu entry, which is drawn as that button
tokens.--color-accent-ink: text set on the teal donate button
tokens.--color-number: warm ochre — reserved for the impact number, nothing else
tokens.--color-panel: quiet tinted panels — the get-involved block, quotes, code
tokens.--color-photo: the field behind the hero photograph while it loads
tokens.--hero-photo-height: height of the hero photograph, when the page has one
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of buttons, panels and photos — rounded but not bubbly
tokens.--rule-accent: thickness of the teal rule beside a quotation
tokens.--focus-ring: thickness of the keyboard focus ring and of the underline that marks the current page on the menu button
tokens.--tap-target: minimum height of buttons and tap targets
